wayreth-black-master.summary: The continent, with the three roads to Wayreth drawn on it. Start here and come back to it whenever the party chooses a route.
The house of a dead man who knew more than he said. The funeral is downstairs; what matters is upstairs.
The village green on festival day. Everything the party is about to lose is standing on this map.
The forest is not navigated; it decides. Ordinary pathfinding fails here and that is the point.

scenes.name: Tower of Wayreth · The Master's Chamber

wayreth-black-master.summary: Raistlin gives the errand here, in public, without ceremony, and the lack of ceremony is the message.
Whichever road they chose, it looks like this for the first day: ruts, ash, and people going the other way.

scenes.name: The Road of Ash · Night Camp

wayreth-black-master.summary: First night on the road. Watches, firelight, and the first honest conversation about what they have been sent to do.
Fangoth, Lemish Core or Ergoth Waters depending on the road taken. The same four beats land in any of them.
The comfortable room where the offer gets made. Gilthanost or Mirivale, or wherever the road put them.
Veyrath's command camp. He invites, he is courteous, and he is recording every answer.
Something has happened on the road ahead and the party has to decide whose problem it is.
A Solamnic staging camp. Resupply, a war briefing, and the first White Robe who will talk to them properly.
The raid everyone is watching, and the theft nobody is. Veyrath is here for the second one.
The white city. Entry, orientation, and the one direction nobody walks in.

Session 10: City of White Stone, Black Shadow
Session 10: City of White Stone, Black Shadow
Session 10: City of White Stone, Black Shadow

wayreth-black-master.summary: Three invitations and three districts. The party cannot be in all of them and the choice is the session.
Astinus will see them, refuse them, correct them, and teach them something none of them asked for.

scenes.name: The Great Library · The Missing Record

wayreth-black-master.summary: An audit of what is not there. The gap in the Chronicle is the clue, and the harbour is where it leads.
The boundary. Everything up to the first trees, and the moment the token comes out.
Inside. The Grove responds to who they are rather than what they carry, and at the far end it lets them through.

notes.text: The bar where the crows gathered

wayreth-black-master.summary: The slow water below Vogler where Ispin's boat was burned and set adrift. Wide, shallow at the bars, and the first water the company travelled together.
Open country between the river and the dwarf-road. Nothing to hide behind for a mile in any direction, which cuts both ways.
The pass down to Maelgoth. Good ambush country, and everyone who uses it knows that, including the people who use it for ambushes.
The underground city's outer hall: forge-channel down the middle, stalls along the walls, and the boatwrights who built the folding boat.
A bar across the road, a hut behind it, and a family locked in the back of it. The toll is real; the collectors are not.
Where the red-robed mage and the elves came back. Open ground, three fires, and no cover worth the name once the Fireball lands.
A farmer, a crop, and too many crows. The company is named for this going wrong once already.
Reed, standing water and mud that holds. Where a wild surge put a halfling waist-deep and shouting.
A collapsing stage out over the water with an old knight on the wrong end of it, and crows in the nets below.

notes.text: Darkness, and what is in it

wayreth-black-master.summary: A Solamnic water-channel with two spans fallen in. Dark enough inside that the darkmantles do not need to make their own.

notes.text: It comes out of the cloud

wayreth-black-master.summary: Where the Crows are now. Night camp on the southern bank, the folding boat drawn up, and a wyvern in the cloud above it.
Open river below the camp, running toward the Wayreth country. Boat travel, with boulders in the channel and no bank worth landing on.
A river inn on the south road: one long room, a hearth, and whoever else is going the same way.
The last town of any size before the forest country. Wharf, market, and a militia that has started asking where people are going.
A Conclave-sanctioned wizard dead in his own locked study. The scene is wrong in ways the city watch has not noticed.
Guild registers, Conclave filings and the University's copies. Three records of the same year and none of them agree.
Pre-Cataclysm Palanthas, still down there under the new streets. A hidden residence, and whoever is guarding it.
The Grove as a psychological dungeon: terror, regret, the dead who failed, and one still point to rest in.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Servants' Gate

wayreth-black-master.summary: Three ways in. The Master's road, the subordinate route, and the one nobody has used since the Kingpriest.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Abandoned Conclave

wayreth-black-master.summary: A Conclave session still running three centuries after it ended, debating a war that is already lost.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Apprentice Quarters

wayreth-black-master.summary: A dormitory running the same morning over and over, and one student who is late in a way that matters.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Forbidden Library

wayreth-black-master.summary: Classified by ward rather than subject. The Long Return is in here, and so is somebody else.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Chamber of Echoes

wayreth-black-master.summary: Rooms that replay what was done in them. Silvanesti is in here, and so is the night a Red Robe turned Black.
The wizard whose curse weaponised the Grove. He is still here, and he would like to explain himself.
Documents in a hand that should not exist, dated after the man who wrote them died.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · Observatory of Time

wayreth-black-master.summary: Six futures, shown without comment. The Tower is not warning anyone; it is filing.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Necromantic Vault

wayreth-black-master.summary: The dead kept working. They answer a command reflex nobody in the party gave them.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Lower Seals

wayreth-black-master.summary: The breach map, the thing on the other side of it, and Veyrath arriving at the worst possible moment.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Master Arrives

wayreth-black-master.summary: Raistlin walks in through the Shoikan Grove without slowing down, and the Tower opens for him.
Three components, three expeditions, and a Master who will not open the Portal without proof.
The approach to Silvanesti, through grief and displaced people, before anything supernatural starts.
Ruined villages where memory has become a physical residue, and a survivor living the same hour again.
Lorac's dream given architecture. Caramon's last path runs through it, and so does his death.
The nightmare's guardian, rehearsing futures that have not happened, and the Heart of Memory behind him.

Session 6: To the Plains of Death
Session 6: To the Plains of Death
Session 6: To the Plains of Death

wayreth-black-master.summary: Open country under Pax Tharkas's shadow, and the stump of Skullcap on the horizon.
A maze that changes behind you because the hour it is in keeps changing. Navigation is a temporal problem.
Fistandantilus's anchor experiment, still running, and the cost of it visible in the walls.
A possible version of one of the party, three decades on, holding the Chronicle of the Unbroken Hour.
A deck, a crew with its own politics, a rival wreck already on the site, and the descent to come.
A divination chamber under the Blood Sea. Three visions, and the difference between knowing a name and owning it.
A soul-call where refusing is the successful outcome, and a vault that only opens for someone who refused.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The Portal Chamber

wayreth-black-master.summary: The first controlled opening. A safety circle, contact, terms, and something coming through on them.
The war turns, the city notices who turned it, and the contract develops a loophole in public.

scenes.name: Tower of Palanthas · The First Returned

wayreth-black-master.summary: Consent taken before death, a ritual that works, and a command channel nobody admits to building.
The Returned in the street rather than the laboratory. A civil question, an accident, and then an attack.

The Dark One manifests and claims the whole research trail, including the soul they just brought back.

wayreth-black-master.summary: Both walls go. One Tower can be held properly and the other cannot, and the Portal surges while you choose.
A private room, a brother who is not in it, and the first chance Caramon has had to want something himself.
Last preparations, the crossing, and cutting the line behind you because leaving it is worse.

wayreth-black-master.summary: Everything here has had its name taken. The Bell is the only thing that can give one back.
A mechanism for holding souls, which can be mapped, used, redesigned or broken — and all four are offered.
No possession, an offer, a price, and the argument the party has in front of both of them.
Takhisis makes her claim on three fronts at once, and the Portal is still open behind you.
